description: Source code implementation of MemEntryImpl class managing in-memory cache entries with sparse data support, including methods for reading, writing, and managing cache entry state.

classes.name: MemEntryImpl
classes.description: Represents an in-memory cache entry with support for sparse data, managing data streams, sparse data operations, and cache entry lifecycle.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns the key associated with the cache entry.

methods.name: GetLastUsed
methods.description: Returns the last time the entry was used.

methods.name: GetLastModified
methods.description: Returns the last modification time of the entry.

methods.name: GetDataSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the data stream at the given index.

methods.name: ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from the specified stream at a given offset.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes data to the specified stream at a given offset.

methods.name: ReadSparseData
methods.description: Reads sparse data at a specified offset.

methods.name: WriteSparseData
methods.description: Writes sparse data at a specified offset.

methods.name: GetAvailableRange
methods.description: Retrieves the available data range within the entry.

methods.name: CouldBeSparse
methods.description: Indicates if the entry could be sparse.

methods.name: ReadyForSparseIO
methods.description: Checks if the entry is ready for sparse I/O operations.

methods.name: SetLastUsedTimeForTest
methods.description: Sets the last used time for testing purposes.
